The original surgery was opened in the 1960s, by the late and great Dr & Mrs Hammond, for the growing district of Lodge Moor.  One consulting  room, one waiting room, no receptionist, happy patients.

They were both GPs and they later opened a second practice on Witham Road in Broomhill. After the family retired, Lawson Road, Broomhill and Blackbrook Road, Lodge Moor, became the new and current surgery locations for this very large practice.

Times have changed, as has pressure on GP services, and the NHS in general. A GP now tries to balance patient care with funding.  With the miracles of modern medicine, patients are living longer and geriatric care has mushroomed out of proportion and beyond estimates.  Covid has been a watershed in many ways, and we have been told that GPs in general are far busier than before the pandemic and appointment requests have not returned to pre-Covid levels.  But we are three years on and should we expect no increase in appointments for our ageing population?

What should not have changed is the way a GP practice listens to its patients (and equally how the NHS listens to its GPs).  We have gauged opinion and in addition, our reviewer has direct experience of this practice.

Breaking things down, GPs at this practice deliver an excellent service.  However the reception at this practice, over the phone and in person, is generally below expectations, and more often than not, is giving the impression that 'we are far too busy and do you really need to be talking to us'?

Walking into one reception recently (at the request of a GP) was a frosty experience.  There was no good morning, how can I help, just a cold 'Do you have an appointment?'

Whilst waiting, that question was repeated by another member of the reception team who had just come off the phone.  The same approach twice in two minutes, not even a hello, or a pleasant smile.  Our reviewer was left feeling that reception wanted to deflect their visit if at all possible.

Maybe this is the modern world, but when our reviewer was brought up, a pleasant 'good morning' was engrained by parents and teachers alike. That should of course be the same in reverse, and receptionists should be treated politely and not be treated unfairly.

And what about patient need?  Everyone deserves the right to receive an open ear and a welcoming attitude.  Pressure on practices should not seem to deprioritise the individual patient, even if there are spurious visits or needs by some patients.  Maybe some health matters could be dealt with at home or at the Pharmacist, but some people need help to understand how best to help themselves.

Practice receptions across the country may be extremely busy, but something is wrong if the pressures on staff and the GP businesses (which they are) means that the patient feels like they have to dig a tunnel under the surgery walls to get speak to or see a GP.",null,[0,237]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN4cEk3S1FnEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x730305583d2ea056!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICxpI7KQg%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN4cEk3S1FnEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN4cEk3S1FnEi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ3hwSTdLd2dFEhNDZ3dJaTRDZ293WVE4THlHc1FFGi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ3hwSTdLSWcSE0Nnd0lzNkx3b2dZUWdLV2FqQUUiEgkAAAAAAAAAABFWoC49WAUDcyoTQ2d3SWk0Q2dvd1lROEx5R3NRRQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjV1YHo5LKTAxXpc4QGHVwGPJoQoykICigE"],null,[null,[[1,6]]]],"0ahUKEwjV1YHo5LKTAxXpc4QGHVwGPJoQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZsWDJSZlgxOWZSV2hFZEVObGRuVnhla3hJZVVoS1pIZERiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpVYzBOa09HMWZNRFZSV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VObVAwclc2amRPdm9BRRAB",["0x0:0x730305583d2ea056",null,1746784325098998,1746784325098998,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116235894474248435370/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Juliet McKenzie","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJkw1qqWdD17Bw65NsXGB_NOFcvc31QZ5hQ5XsB0pSkgtEudnk=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116235894474248435370?hl=en"],"116235894474248435370",null,2,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["2 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjV1YHo5LKTAxXpc4QGHVwGPJoQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"10 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I've been with this surgery for over 20 years.
